people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.
translations.bsb: Then God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.
translations.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name
translations.asv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
